name: Shrikant Pawade
tagline: AI engineer in Pune, building agents, developer tools and small language models.
intro: I've built an MCP server that diagnoses failed CI runs with evidence instead of guesses, and a matching engine that reconciles GST invoices for chartered accountants. Now I'm fine-tuning a small Qwen model with LoRA and proving it beats the base model on a held-out test set. Where I'm headed: agents that reason, use tools and learn from feedback, and the frontier systems behind them.
description: Shrikant Pawade, an AI engineer in Pune. Projects, essays and notes on training small language models.
